author: Sho
body:
Hello everyone! We are PROXIMITY, an Avicus tourney team. I know we have an LFM but it's in the LFT section ever since the update so I'm just reformatting most of the stuff. We like to have fun and are a group of friends but obviously treat it quite seriously when it comes to scrimmages and of course, tournament matches. Sounds cool huh? We have a scrimmage server and we do scrim almost every weekend. 

There are certain requirements to join if this sounds appealing enough to you. 

  • Obviously you have to prioritise proximity over other teams. Being a sub in another team IS PERMITTED, however you must always prioritise proximity in terms of attending scrimmages. 
  • You must be fairy active. This doesn't mean 8 hours in the basement a day but a decent amount of time on ts3 and skype, and in-game as well. If you're gonna be active due to IRL stoof that's perfectly fine. just let us know or something. Timezones do not matter that much. Just be flexible if you are Asia/AU.
  • Be mature. There is no age requirement but squealing into your mic isn't exactly the most pleasant sound to listen too. Joking around is fine but keep it to a minimum during scrims.
  • To be able to take criticism and improve as a team. We are here to help not insult. Suck it up and take it. 
  • To have skype, ts3, and preferebly a working mic. (skype + ts3 are an absolute)
Sound appealing huh? Well then what are you waiting for fill out the app! (Applications ARE OPEN for now)
